mechanism_narrative: A surge in housing starts (HOUST) above 650K units, indicating strong demand, boosts consumer confidence, leading to increased spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical correlation between HOUST and consumer confidence
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of instances when HOUST > 650K, or Rank IC < 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) below 0.5% signals an accommodative monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as investors seek higher yields.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) drops below 8% and payroll employment (PAYEMS) increases by more than 200K in a month, the combined signal of a strong labor market boosts S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (INDPRO) above its 6-month moving average, signaling a supply chain pickup, leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days, as manufacturers' growth prospects improve.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) when INDPRO > 6mo MA.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the GDP annual growth rate (GDPC1) below 2%, indicating sluggish demand, leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days, as investors reassess growth prospects.
evidence_refs: fact:historical GDP growth and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 50% of instances when GDPC1 < 2%, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, the combined signal of tightening monetary policy and rising inflation leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal: the labor market's influence on consumer spending ensures that payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth consistently predicts positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical labor market indicators and consumer spending
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When retail sales (RSAFS) increase by more than 1% in a month and housing starts (HOUST) are above 550K units, the combined signal of strong demand across multiple sectors leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
evidence_refs: fact:historical demand indicators and stock market performance
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of instances when both conditions are met, or Rank IC < 0.01 over any 3-year rolling window.
